1. Read the requirement yaml. Note the JIRA id and the module it belongs to (HDFS / YARN / MAPREDUCE / HADOOP-common / tools).

title: HDFS-16526. Add metrics for slow DataNode
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  HDFS operators need clearer visibility into slow DataNode behavior so they can tell whether replication or write pipelines are being delayed by local disk work or by slow acknowledgements moving upstream through the pipeline. Without dedicated counters, these cases are harder to spot and diagnose from routine monitoring.


  ## Desired outcome

  DataNode metrics should expose separate counters for these slow-path conditions so monitoring systems can distinguish them directly. The exported metric contract needs to include `SlowFlushOrSyncCount` for delayed flush or sync activity and `SlowAckToUpstreamCount` for delayed upstream acknowledgements, without changing normal write behavior.


  ## Acceptance signals

  DataNode metrics now publish `SlowFlushOrSyncCount` and `SlowAckToUpstreamCount`, slow flush-or-sync events increment the former, slow upstream-ack events increment the latter, and the change adds observability only without altering the underlying pipeline semantics.

  '
